title: Plural demonstratives: nämä, nuo, ne
summary: Recall the three written plural demonstrative forms in a fully supplied sentence frame.
objectives: Connect nämä, nuo, and ne with their supplied reference labels.
Recall each written form while the plural identity frame is visible.
Leave reference-choice and noun-agreement decisions for the later Focused lessons.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: The plural demonstratives are nämä, nuo, and ne.
They correspond to the singular reference families tämä, tuo, and se, but each refers to more than one.

sections.title: Recall only the written form
paragraphs: These first tasks supply the plural identity sentence and its reference label. Your one decision is which written demonstrative completes it.
Later Focused lessons remove that support and ask you to choose from the situation or use the form in a new sentence pattern.

commonMistakes: Do not use tämä, tuo, or se for several referents.
Do not choose nuo from English “those” without reading the scene.
Do not pair a plural demonstrative with on.

practiceExercises.explanation: Nämä is the plural demonstrative for a situation where the referents are close to the speaker.
